# buildfile.txt

# The target 'build' depends on 'src/main.rs' and 'src/other.rs'.
build: src/main.rs src/other.rs
    rustc src/main.rs src/other.rs -o output/my_program

# Clean up generated files
clean:
    rm -f output/my_program
    rm -f src/*.o

# Another custom target (e.g., run the program)
run: output/my_program
    ./output/my_program
